key_insight: Read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raises quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of perovskite solar cells require structured experimental records, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Equip an open 14B language model with read-only SQL on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reaches 51.5% on historical literature and 50.8% on prospective literature, compared with 1.6–6.5% zero-shot accuracy.
watch_item: Accuracy remains near 51%, and deployment depends on reliable extraction and maintenance of structured device tables.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
